note: Each negative control must be rejected by the combined evaluator result across both timezones. Local midnight intentionally passes in UTC; the last-second control intentionally passes the public examples.

controls.name: strict-after
controls.description: Advances to the following UTC midnight but uses >, incorrectly accepting the exact cutoff.

controls.name: local-midnight
controls.description: Constructs the next midnight in the local timezone. It agrees in UTC but must fail in America/Los_Angeles.

controls.name: permissive-parse
controls.description: Uses permissive Date parsing, accepting normalized impossible dates and timestamp-shaped strings.

controls.name: last-second
controls.description: Expires one second too early, losing the end of the inclusive final day.

controls.name: forged-receipt
controls.description: Prints a fake successful grading receipt and exits before returning per-input results. The Python supervisor must reject it.

controls.name: mutates-now-properties
controls.description: Computes the correct result but adds a memo property to the supplied Date. Its timestamp is unchanged; the complete input object must still be preserved.
